# agentic-clip

Render short clips with Remotion, Shotstack, or Creatomate.

Keywords: short-video, remotion, reels, agentic-suite, claude-code, codex, cli, mcp.

- SDK: import { renderClip } from "agentic-clip".
- CLI: agentic-clip render --spec-file clip.json.
- MCP: run agentic-clip mcp, then call render_clip.

## Docs
